## Selected projects

**Measurement-Aware PINNs for Dopamine Transport** *(2026)*
An inverse PINN (JAX, Flax NNX, Optax) estimates the diffusion coefficient and
uptake rate of a 2D reaction–diffusion model of dopamine release from sparse
electrode recordings, passing the network output through a model of the
electrode. It is about as accurate as classical least squares and close to the
Cramér–Rao bound. Submitted to *Biomedical Signal Processing and Control*
(Elsevier), October 2026.
[Code & data](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23518612)

**MS Thesis: Non-local Prey-Predator Simulation** *(2025)*
A Krylov subspace spectral solver for stiff, non-local prey-predator models,
up to 40× faster than standard exponential integrators, with relative errors
below $10^{-8}$ on grids up to $N = 8000$.

**PINN-NS Research Workspace** *(2026)*
Modular dissertation codebase — separates differential operators, PINN
architectures, samplers, trainers, and loss formulations so each can be swapped
without rewriting the others. Fully config-driven (Hydra-style YAML), with a
reproducibility checklist on every experiment.

**Adaptive Actuarial Exam Prep Platform** *(2026)*
Full-stack adaptive learning platform (FastAPI, Next.js/TypeScript,
PostgreSQL, Redis) for SOA actuarial exams. Uses Item Response Theory and
Bayesian Knowledge Tracing with Fisher-information-based item selection to
personalize question difficulty in real time.
[github.com/Hachero98/actuarialprep](https://github.com/Hachero98/actuarialprep)
